images.prompt: Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot of a time-loop farming game titled "되돌릴 수 있는 한 해", immediately after rewinding to spring. Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Composition: night-blue starfield; left, the illuminated calendar wheel with the gold needle back at day one, a glowing gold sweep of light spinning around the rim, and vermilion marginalia dots with short handwritten notes of remembered events (frost, rain, price swings) placed on specific days. Right: a large gilded headline, a parchment memory ledger listing remembered days in vermilion numerals, a parchment crop panel with gold bars showing how many plots can still grow each crop and the grape line locked in vermilion, and a strip of twelve dark soil plots each bearing three vermilion scar notches. Feeling: knowledge gained, land diminished. Palette: midnight blue, gold leaf, vellum, vermilion. Korean UI: headline "다시, 봄", "기억한 날 · 84일", "포도 6칸". Calendar constraints: the rim has 112 plain tick marks with no per-day numerals except 1, 28, 56 and 84 at the four quarter positions (1 at the top, increasing clockwise); spring is the top-right quarter (days 1-28), then summer, autumn, winter; each remembered-event dot sits at its correct proportional day position (8일, 14일, 21일, 27일 all inside the spring quarter, 33일 just past 28 in summer); no duplicated or out-of-order numbers.
